gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-thin strokes that never swell or taper, like a pen that ignores pressure. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement follows with round, parenthesis-like forms and a stocky middle band, giving the line a sturdier footing underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-thai-: Noto Sans Thai Looped reads bold and weighty, its lowercase bodies stretched high, with generous gaps where the curves end. Funnel Display, by contrast, keeps a ballpoint's pressure-free line, expressive up top while the plain sans below does the steady work.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-ugari: Funnel Display has a commanding, expressive voice, drawn with the unvarying line of a stencil brush. And Noto Sans Ugaritic sits close beneath it, its capitals barely rising over the lowercase, with open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-no: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display lets its letters stay open and its x-height stand proud above the line. Noto Sans Old North Arabian reads dense and compact over many lines.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-pe: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display keeps its letters from pinching shut and lifts its x-height high. And Noto Sans Old Persian carries on below with lofty lowercase and open counters, which makes a long read feel easy to breathe through.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-stack-sans-text: Autour One runs a clear channel into each round letter, with no shift from hairline to stem. Stack Sans Text matches that steadiness with a marker-like constant line, curve endings held well apart, and big-bodied lowercase, which is the pair's real strength.
